before: the prospective start (2026-10-19), before any B1 formation, and before any symbol has been reported unavailable; no TradFi price, return or funding value was computed or viewed
decided_by: the assistant, under the user's 2026-10-16 instruction to proceed with all open decisions; the user may replace this rule by a further amendment, which then applies only to formations after its own date
resolves: amendment 1 open_rule (a stock-book symbol that stays unavailable on Yahoo keeps B1 pending)

rule.trigger: the same Yahoo symbol appears in b1_yahoo_blocked (reason 'yahoo_unavailable:<sym>') at two consecutive monthly B1 formations in the watch report
rule.resolution: from the next formation after the trigger onward, that symbol is removed from the B1 ranking universe and B1 is formed on the remaining symbols with the frozen 12-1 momentum rule, quantiles and leverage unchanged; earlier formations stay as reported (pending)
rule.flag: the report must list every excluded symbol with the formation date of its exclusion (b1_excluded_unavailable)
rule.implementation: the code change that applies the exclusion is committed only after the trigger is observed, cites the two report artifacts that show it, and changes nothing else; B0, B2, costs, delisting handling and the calendar check are untouched
rule.pnl_independence: the trigger uses data availability only, never a return, price level or ranking outcome

known_limitation: a symbol that disappears from Yahoo after a corporate event may be one with unusual returns, so exclusion can bias B1 slightly; the flag makes every exclusion visible at review
